name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 5 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2025-06-24, at wavelengths from 1.34 to 4.72 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
